title: Kissed by Binchotan Brazilian Beef Patty
description: A rich and decadent Brazilian beef patty, kissed by the flavorful Binchotan grill, and cooked to perfection with double-frying for an extra crispy crust.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, garlic, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Add the beaten egg and mix until the meat is just holding together.
Add the breadcrumbs and mix until the meat is evenly coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Preheat the Binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
Using your hands, shape the meat mixture into 4-6 patties, depending on the desired size.
Place the patties onto the grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the patties from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
To double-fry the patties, heat about 1 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the oil is hot, add the patties and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the patties from the oil and place them onto a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the Kissed by Binchotan Brazilian Beef Patty hot, garnished with your favorite toppings.
